title: SectionedTree forces a filter box and an expand-all control on every section
foundBy: an agent building a six-section navigation sidebar against 0.2.0, relayed by the repository owner
details:
`SectionedTree` renders a filter input and an expand-all control for every section, and neither can be turned off. It sets `filterable`, `onToggleExpandAll` and `allExpanded` on each child Tree itself, and exposes none of them on its own props.

With six sections that is six filter boxes and six expand-all controls, most of them over sections of two to eleven items. In a 300px sidebar the chrome outweighed the content.

The inconsistency is the argument for calling this a defect. Plain `Tree` offers `filterable` as opt-in. `SectionedTree` composes Trees and removes a choice the composed component gives.

Worked around in the consuming app by abandoning SectionedTree for Panel plus Tree per section, with a filter only on sections above twenty items. That took six filter boxes down to two.

notes.text: Confirmed: src/components/SectionedTree.tsx:311-315 passes filterable, onToggleExpandAll and allExpanded unconditionally. SectionedTreeProps at lines 26-48 exposes none of the three.
